[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=465 }} The [[Nightfallen Jahai]] is a dark mockery of [[Jahai Bluffs]] in [[Kourna]]. Even the [[Elon|Elon River]] is mirrored; in its place is the [[River of Souls]]. The Sun is black and twisted. This area is outside the [[Gate of Torment]] and is the first [[explorable area]] in the [[Realm of Torment]] that your party will traverse. ==Getting there== The [[primary quest]] [[Uncharted Territory]], available from the [[Gate of Torment]], will continue the storyline and lead the party across this area. Many [[secondary quest]]s from the Gate of Torment take place here. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: *[[Forgotten Warden]] → [[Margonite Battle]] **At the southeastern
